content.subject: Sandbox testing for fulfillment
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
ShipBob’s Simulation Terminal is now in every sandbox account. That lets teams test fulfillment flows without touching live inventory, reducing manual reconciliation before go-live.
We build bots that reconcile sandbox data to source systems, eliminating hand‑coded mapping steps.
Do you have 20 minutes next week to see if it fits?
Zamp
